100% Whey Gold Standard

 

WONDERFUL NEW TASTE, 100% GOLD STANDARD.


Optimum Nutrition's 100% Whey Gold Standard is the world's best-selling whey protein. Provides 24 g whey protein to support muscle growth.

 

After training, your body uses protein to help repair and reconstruct muscle fibers. Each serving of excellent taste contains 24 g of high-quality whey protein to support muscle growth and 5.5 g of natural BCAAs. All with just 1.4 g of fat, 0.7 g of sugars and with 1.3 g of carbohydrates.

 

BENEFITS

    24 grams whey protein with low sugar and fat levels and less than 120 calories.
    5.5 grams BCAAs of course in each serving
    4 grams of glutamine & glutamino acid
    Enjoy the first thing in the morning and/or after training
    Available in a range of different serving sizes and flavors

fields.name: Complete Pre 495g (Warriorlab)
fields.description:
Balanced pre-workout energy, focus and muscle pump
Complete Pre by Warriorlab is a pre-workout formula designed to give your body the extra push it needs before training, without excessive stimulation. Its balanced composition delivers clean energy, mental focus, and muscle blood flow—without the typical “crash” of many pre-workouts.

Key Features

    Clean, steady energy without sudden drops
    Fully disclosed dosages, no proprietary blends
    Suitable for all training styles and fitness levels

Benefits & Advantages

    Enhances focus, motivation, and workout readiness
    Improves muscle blood flow and pump
    Supports endurance, strength, and training consistency

What you will feel

    Refreshing, thirst-quenching sensation that wakes up your senses
    Clear mental focus and smooth energy from the start
    Strong muscle pump and fullness during training
    A ready, activated body for demanding workouts

Why choose it?
Because Complete Pre delivers smart, balanced pre-workout support—helping you train harder and more focused without overstimulation or unwanted crashes.

Ideal combination with:

    Complete 8 – for all-day muscle support
    Mineral Light – for hydration and electrolytes
    •BCAA – for muscle protection during intense sessions


Caution:  After a few days of use of this product (as well as most of pre workouts), you may notice a "rock" feature. This in no way implies alteration of the product. Instead, it is a natural process, which is due to the existence of many "hygroscopic" ingredients (such as Arginine and Beta Alanine), which means that these ingredients attract water and hold its molecules. So when the package opens and the product comes in contact with the humidity of the environment, the poweder is "thickened".
It is perfectly normal and all that the consumer needs is to smash the larger pieces with a spoon to facilitate its dissolution without altering the product.
The product is recommended to be consumed within 2-4 weeks after opening the package. The longer the package is left, the more the powder lumpier it will get.
